Volusion e-commerce sites skimmed via script.

Target: Volusion (via Google Cloud Storage script)
Repository: N/A
Date: 2019-10-07 to 2019-10-09 (2 days)
Attribution: Cybercriminal Gang
Component: Script
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Cloud storage compromise
Motive: Financial gain
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Credential theft, Data theft
User Impact: 29500
Domain: storage.googleapis.com (CDN host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Over 29,500 e-commerce websites hosted on the Volusion platform were compromised when a malicious JavaScript file (volusion.js), hosted on a Google Cloud Storage bucket (storage.googleapis.com/volusionapi/resources/) used by Volusion, was modified. This script skimmed credit card information, exfiltrating it to gogogolo.com.
